regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Delay progression in BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer when chemotherapy is not clinically indicated. This treatment aims to control advanced cancer.
regimen_profiles.treatment_setting: BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer when chemotherapy is not clinically indicated.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Niraparib inhibits PARP proteins used in DNA repair. BRCA-altered cancer already has a weakness in another repair pathway, making this additional block more damaging to cancer cells. Abiraterone reduces androgen production by blocking CYP17. Prednisolone limits the hormone imbalance caused by that block.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Usual starting dose: two Akeega 100/500 mg tablets once daily, plus prednisolone 10 mg daily. Continue your hormone injections unless you have had surgical castration. Treatment is continuous, with no routine rest week.
key_points: Usual starting dose: two Akeega 100/500 mg tablets once daily, plus prednisolone 10 mg daily. Continue your hormone injections unless you have had surgical castration. Treatment is continuous, with no routine rest week.

Blood count: weekly in month 1, fortnightly in months 2-3, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Liver tests: fortnightly for months 1-3, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Blood pressure: weekly for two months, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Potassium: monthly to year 1, then every two months.

Do not stop prednisolone suddenly, including when Akeega is held. Ask about steroid cover during illness. Dose reductions differ for low blood counts and liver injury; always follow the exact tablet strength and number on the revised prescription. Use condoms with a pregnant partner, or condoms plus another effective method with a partner who could become pregnant, during treatment and for four months after the last dose.

treatment_rationale.summary: Akeega adds DNA-repair targeting and further androgen suppression to the ADT backbone. The current NCCP 00848 service is for BRCA1/2-mutated castration-resistant disease. The newer European hormone-sensitive indication uses a different steroid dose and needs a separate prescribing and reimbursement decision. Radiotherapy may still have a role for symptoms or another agreed local treatment goal.

patient_selection.treatment_intent: Delay progression in BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer when chemotherapy is not clinically indicated. This treatment aims to control advanced cancer.
disease_and_biomarker_context: BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer when chemotherapy is not clinically indicated.
eligibility_orientation: mCRPC with germline and/or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation
important_cautions: Current EMA indication also includes BRCA-mutated mHSPC with prednisolone 5 mg/day. NCCP 00848 v2 remains mCRPC with 10 mg/day; no automatic indication or reimbursement expansion.
NCCP/SmPC severe hepatotoxicity includes ALT or AST 20 ×ULN; the encoded stop includes equality.
The SmPC adds a permanent stop when haematological toxicity fails to recover within 28 days; this supplements NCCP recurrence tables.

premedication_and_prophylaxis: Moderate-to-high sickness risk: discuss preventive anti-sickness medicine for the first two weeks and ongoing treatment if needed. Follow the local prescribed plan; check interactions.
Prednisolone remains a separate prescription when Akeega is held. Do not stop suddenly; ask for a steroid alert card and illness/stress-dose advice.

Do not stop prednisolone suddenly, including when Akeega is held. Ask about steroid cover during illness. Dose reductions differ for low blood counts and liver injury; always follow the exact tablet strength and number on the revised prescription. Use condoms with a pregnant partner, or condoms plus another effective method with a partner who could become pregnant, during treatment and for four months after the last dose.
Discuss fracture risk, calcium intake, vitamin D, suitable resistance and aerobic exercise and falls prevention. Supplements and bone medicines follow the individual plan.
Bring all prescribed medicines, over-the-counter medicines and supplements. Ask pharmacy before starting or stopping anything.

Call immediately for fever or infection, unusual bleeding, jaundice or persistent vomiting. Severe chest pain, sudden breathlessness, collapse, seizure, confusion or major vision changes: call 112/999.

baseline: Confirm BRCA1/2 result and cancer setting. Check full blood count, kidney/liver tests, potassium, glucose and blood pressure; review heart disease, medicines and bone health. ECG or echocardiogram is arranged when indicated.
before_each_cycle: Blood count: weekly in month 1, fortnightly in months 2-3, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Liver tests: fortnightly for months 1-3, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Blood pressure: weekly for two months, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Potassium: monthly to year 1, then every two months.

priority_toxicities: Low red cells (anaemia), low platelets and infection risk from low white cells
Nausea, vomiting, constipation, fatigue and poor appetite
High blood pressure, dizziness or headache
Rare bone-marrow cancers (MDS/AML); rare severe neurological syndrome (PRES)
High blood pressure, fluid retention and low potassium
Liver injury, occasionally severe or fatal

Muscle symptoms, bone loss and fractures
Raised glucose, appetite or sleep and mood changes
Infection risk, stomach irritation and bone effects
Adrenal insufficiency if withdrawn suddenly or during illness
monitoring_and_toxicity.disease_monitoring: PSA helps assess cancer activity. Testosterone tests check hormone suppression. Symptoms, results and scans are reviewed together; there is no single scan interval for everyone.

administration.cycle_and_sequence: Usual starting dose: two Akeega 100/500 mg tablets once daily, plus prednisolone 10 mg daily. Continue your hormone injections unless you have had surgical castration. Treatment is continuous, with no routine rest week.
route_and_duration: Take Akeega whole with water at least two hours after food, then wait at least one hour before eating. Take prednisolone with food. If a dose is missed, take it as soon as possible on the same day; do not take extra tablets. Check with the team after vomiting. The two Akeega strengths are not interchangeable.
practical_workflow: Blood count: weekly in month 1, fortnightly in months 2-3, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Potassium: monthly to year 1, then every two months.

evidence_at_a_glance.population: MAGNITUDE BRCA1/2 subgroup: 225 participants with first-line mCRPC; 113 assigned niraparib plus abiraterone/steroid.
evidence_at_a_glance.comparison: Niraparib + abiraterone/prednisone versus placebo + abiraterone/prednisone; ADT maintained.
evidence_at_a_glance.applicability: BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer when chemotherapy is not clinically indicated.
evidence_at_a_glance.qualitative_result: At the primary analysis, median time without scan progression or death was 16.6 versus 10.9 months; hazard ratio 0.533 (95% CI 0.361-0.789). Final overall-survival HR was 0.788 (95% CI 0.554-1.120), which did not establish an overall-survival advantage. The progression and survival analyses used different data cut-offs. These figures are not an individual prediction.

Radiographic progression-free survival is not overall survival.
